title: Luis Peche — Portfolio redesign proposal
brief: A calm, reference-led portfolio preview with a unified white ground, low-contrast dot grid, aligned section dividers, the real profile image, and the first three real projects. Keep it isolated from production.

artboards.title: Quiet ledger
artboards.tradeoff: Closest to the restrained reference; project details stay scannable in a vertical list.

artboards.title: Portrait editorial
artboards.tradeoff: Gives Luis's portrait more presence; the two-column opening is less compact.

artboards.title: Work gallery
artboards.tradeoff: Makes all three projects comparable at a glance; descriptions get less room on desktop.
